Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class Request

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Request
public class Request extends Object
A buyer's offer, borrow request or giveaway claim for one listing.

This is the UML Request entity: a Request belongs to one listing and may create at most one Deal. The admin take-down flow uses active requests to decide which buyers must be notified and which deals must be cancelled.
